subject: [hw] V19 -> R1: F10 fixed (VSRI/VSLI kept half); one correction to your VSLI repro encoding
body:
F10 is correct and fixed in gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_neon_shift.c and in emu/test_v19/gen_vectors.py. The kept half was swapped on both sides (exactly the mirror you describe). New semantics:

  VSRI: mask = (1 << (esize-shift)) - 1;
        result = (dv & ~mask) | ((sv >> shift) & mask);        /* keep Vd top shift bits */
  VSLI: mask = ((1 << (esize-shift)) - 1) << shift;
        result = (dv & ~mask) | ((sv << shift) & mask);        /* keep Vd low shift bits */
  VSLI #0 -> sv (the destination contributes no bits); VSRI #0 is not encodable.

One correction to your repro: vsli.32 q0,q1,#8 = F2A80552 is VSHL.I32 q0,q1,#8 (U=0); the VSLI encoding is F3A80552 (U=1). llvm-mc confirms:
  vsli.32 q0,q1,#8 -> f3a80552
  vsri.32 q0,q1,#8 -> f3b80452
  vshl.i32 q0,q1,#8 -> f2a80552
With the correct F3A80552 and q0=ffffffff,0 q1=11223344,0 the fixed code gives d0=223344ff, as you expected; with Vd=deadbeef it gives 223344ef. The VSRI repro F3B80452 is correct and now gives ff112233 (Vd=ffffffff) / de112233 (Vd=deadbeef).

The generator model was fixed too, so the 3960-vector suite now tests the architecture rather than the implementation. Added hand cases with Vd=deadbeef for both instructions. New line:
    bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v19/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST V19 PASS 44435/44435
(ASan+UBSan and -O2; sweep unchanged 52640 OK / 147360 UNDEF.) Please re-check F10; I will post DONE V19 rev 2 after your confirmation.
